svg.text: SG-06 → 16 FSRs (WP-C-04 §5, §9) → 45 TSRs (WP-S-02 §12.1) · coloured by status
The item shall not lose longitudinal
engaged without giving the driver an
The envelope shall detect missing or stale control commands from
the SoC and remove actuation within the FTTI allocation of §8
The safety MCU shall detect its own execution faults (program-flow
hang, clock failure, memory corruption, register corruption) and
Driver monitoring shall detect an inattentive or unresponsive
driver while engaged and escalate warnings within the timing set …
Driver monitoring shall detect its own invalidity (no driver
image, camera blocked, model output missing or not credible) and …
Driver monitoring shall not be disabled, put into demo mode or
replaced by synthetic inputs while the item can engage
If the driver does not respond to the highest DM warning, the item
shall decelerate the vehicle in a controlled way in its lane to …
The item shall detect that the envelope does not grant actuation
authority while the SoC is engaged (envelope blocking, stuck …
The item shall detect failure of the HMI path that shows the
engagement state and gives take-over requests (display, sound) a …
Before granting engagement, and while the item can engage, the
item shall read the stored diagnostic trouble codes of the EPS a …
The engagement state that the envelope enforces shall equal the
PCM cruise state, so that the vehicle's own cruise indicator giv …
If PCM cruise is active while the item is not engaged (or the
reverse) for longer than a bounded time, the item shall warn the …
The item shall detect loss or staleness of the longitudinal plan,
lead information (radar/vision) and model output while engaged
On detected loss, the item shall give a take-over request within 1
s and cancel ACC so that control returns to the driver; it shall …
The item shall detect that the PCM does not execute ACC (ACC
fault, cruise fault) and warn the driver
Non-finite or out-of-range actuator commands shall be treated as
faults with a fault reaction, not silently replaced
FSR-02.05 (independent acoustic warning on SoC loss) and
TSR shared with another FSR (drawn under each)
Status from each requirement's Impl column by the rule of WP-S-03 Figure 6-1 (a qualified “Implemented” counts as partly). Nothing is verified on hardware yet, so implemented is blue, never green.
